title: Normalized comparison roof and continuity property
statement: Use [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models] and the unique comparison of [lem-sfb-internal-hom-comparison-exists]. Define comparison to be that unique normalized natural transformation. Define roofDenominator(T)=homFixed(P)(tensor(T,eta_L)). For a fixed filtered index category I, Continuous(P) means that for every diagram M of complexes with a common termwise lower bound, colimit.post M homFixed(P) is a quasi-isomorphism. No data are chosen from mere existence: comparison is determined uniquely by Normalized.
